local FORM_PATHS = { "^/new/payment/", "3ds" }

local function on_boosty(host)
  return host == "boosty.to" or (host:sub(-10) == ".boosty.to" and not host:match("^api"))
end

local function in_form(path)
  for _, form in ipairs(FORM_PATHS) do
    if path:match(form) then return true end
  end
  return false
end

local function navigate(url)
  local text = tostring(url or "")
  local host, rest = text:match("^https://([^/?#]+)(.*)$")
  if host == nil or host:find("[:@]") or not on_boosty(string.lower(host)) then return { state = "page" } end
  if in_form(rest:match("^/[^?#]*") or "") then return { state = "page" } end
  local verdict = text:match("[?&]result=([^&#]*)")
  if verdict == nil or verdict == "success" then return { state = "pending" } end
  return { state = "pending", reason = "confirm_failed" }
end
if inputs.action == "navigate" then return navigate(inputs.url) end
return { state = "pending" }
